speaker: BLUE ROBED PRIEST
description: A middle-aged male priest with a crisp, resonant timbre and formal, ecclesiastical diction. His baseline delivery is chilly, measured, and arrogantly authoritative, reflecting a traditionalist hierarchy; pace is deliberate and precise. Under pressure his composure fractures — pitch rises sharply, pace accelerates into panicked staccato, and the voice cracks with rising hysteria. Guide the performance from cold command into uncontrolled panic when the ritual goes awry.
